itemized.notes: A near-dormant year-end filing (YEAR-END January-31 box checked; amendment answered 'No'; cover stamped COPY). BOTH itemized schedules exist as printed pages and BOTH are completely blank, with '-0-' written into all four subtotal/total cells - honest zeros, not missing pages. THE ONE REAL ANOMALY IS THE FILER'S: the Summary Page reports 4.97 of contributions this period (line 1 Col A, line 4, and Column B) but Schedule A itemizes nothing and totals '-0-'. A 4.97 figure on an otherwise dormant account reads like bank interest, but the form does not say so and nothing was inferred - both figures are kept verbatim and the discrepancy is named rather than reconciled. No contributor or recipient names appear anywhere in this filing, so no privacy handling was needed beyond the cover page.
